mapper.select:
select
from ins_tag_client where tag_name = #{tagLibClientName} and tag_type = #{tagType} and identifier = #{identifier}

select
from ins_tag_client where id = #{tagLibClientId}

WITH RECURSIVE CTE AS (SELECT * FROM ins_tag_client WHERE id = #{tagLibClientId} UNION ALL SELECT t.* FROM ins_tag_client t INNER JOIN CTE ON t.id = CTE.tag_parent_id) SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(tag_name SEPARATOR '#') as tag_name FROM CTE where CTE.id != #{tagLibClientId} group by tag_type ORDER BY tag_code

WITH RECURSIVE CTE AS (SELECT * FROM ins_tag_client WHERE 1=1
and id in
#{item}
UNION ALL SELECT t.* FROM ins_tag_client t INNER JOIN CTE ON t.tag_parent_id = CTE.id where 1=1 ) SELECT * FROM CTE ORDER BY id

WITH RECURSIVE CTE AS ( -- 从最末级开始 SELECT id, tag_parent_id, tag_name, tag_code, level, emotion, 1 as depth FROM ins_tag_client WHERE 1=1
and id in
#{item}
and tag_name=#{model.tagName} and tag_type="CA"
UNION ALL
-- 向上查找父级 SELECT t.id, t.tag_parent_id, t.tag_name, t.tag_code, t.level, t.emotion, CTE.depth + 1 as depth FROM ins_tag_client t INNER JOIN CTE ON t.id = CTE.tag_parent_id ) SELECT -- 第1级：根节点（深度最大的） MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN id END) as firstId, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN tag_name END) as firstName, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN tag_code END) as firstCode, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN level END) as firstLevel, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN emotion END) as firstEmotion,
-- 第2级 MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN id END) as secondId, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN tag_name END) as secondName, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN tag_code END) as secondCode, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN level END) as secondLevel, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN emotion END) as secondEmotion,
-- 第3级 MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 3 THEN id END) as thirdId, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 3 THEN tag_name END) as thirdName, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 3 THEN tag_code END) as thirdCode, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 3 THEN level END) as thirdLevel, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 3 THEN emotion END) as thirdEmotion,
-- 第4级 MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 4 THEN id END) as fourthId, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 4 THEN tag_name END) as fourthName, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 4 THEN tag_code END) as fourthCode, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 4 THEN level END) as fourthLevel, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 4 THEN emotion END) as fourthEmotion,
-- 第5级：最末级（深度最小的） MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 5 THEN id END) as fifthId, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 5 THEN tag_name END) as fifthName, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 5 THEN tag_code END) as fifthCode, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 5 THEN level END) as fifthLevel, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 5 THEN emotion END) as fifthEmotion,
-- 完整的路径信息 GROUP_CONCAT(tag_name ORDER BY depth DESC SEPARATOR ' > ') as fullNamePath, GROUP_CONCAT(tag_code ORDER BY depth DESC SEPARATOR ' > ') as fullCodePath, GROUP_CONCAT(id ORDER BY depth DESC SEPARATOR ' > ') as fullIdPath,
-- 总层级数 MAX(depth) as totalLevels FROM ( SELECT *, -- 为每级分配序号（根节点为1，依次递增） ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY depth DESC) as rn FROM CTE ORDER BY depth DESC -- 根节点在最前面 ) as numbered

select distinct user_id from ( select create_user as user_id from ins_tag_client where tag_attribute = 'Category' and create_user is not null and create_user != '' union select update_user as user_id from ins_tag_client where tag_attribute = 'Category' and update_user is not null and update_user != '' ) operator_users

select itc.tag_name, itc.tag_code from ins_tag_client itc
group by itc.tag_code

select itc.id, itc.tag_parent_id, itc.tag_name, itc.tag_name_en, itc.tag_code, itc.tag_type, itc.tag_attribute, itc.energy_type, itc.car_type, itc.tag_status, itc.tag_description, itc.seriousness, itc.user_journey1, itc.user_journey2, itc.scenario_attr, itc.attribute_label_ids, itc.event_clarity, ssd.name as d2c_responsible_dept, itc.d2c_cc_dept, itc.create_time, itc.update_time, itc.create_user, itc.update_user, itc.app_client, itc.sort, itc.`level`, itc.emotion, itc.intention, itc.d2c_accountable_dept, itc.tag_accuracy, itc.tag_customer_issue_classification, itc.tag_issue_severity, itc.tag_code_status, itc.tag_business_domain, itc.tag_high_value_flag, itc.tag_complaint_flag_needing_reply, itc.tag_high_quality_voc_flag, itc.tag_new_energy_or_fuel, itc.tag_need_forvclosed_loop, itc.mapping_code, itc.identifier, itc.susceptive_type, itc.synonyms from ins_tag_client itc left join sta_sys_depart ssd on ssd.id = itc.d2c_responsible_dept
group by itc.tag_code order by itc.create_time desc

WITH RECURSIVE CTE AS ( -- 从所有末级节点开始 SELECT id, tag_parent_id, tag_name, tag_code, level, emotion, tag_type, 1 as depth, id as leaf_id, CAST(id AS CHAR(1000)) as hierarchy_path FROM ins_tag_client WHERE tag_code in
#{item}
and tag_attribute = 'FinalLabel'
UNION ALL
-- 向上递归 SELECT t.id, t.tag_parent_id, t.tag_name, t.tag_code, t.level, t.emotion, c.tag_type, -- 继承末级的tag_type c.depth + 1 as depth, c.leaf_id, CONCAT(t.id, ' > ', c.hierarchy_path) as hierarchy_path FROM ins_tag_client t INNER JOIN CTE c ON t.id = c.tag_parent_id ) SELECT tag_type as type, leaf_id as last_level_id,
-- 使用PIVOT动态获取各层级信息 MAX(CASE WHEN depth = max_depth THEN id END) as first_id, MAX(CASE WHEN depth = max_depth THEN tag_name END) as first_name, MAX(CASE WHEN depth = max_depth THEN tag_code END) as first_code,
MAX(CASE WHEN depth = max_depth - 1 THEN id END) as second_id, MAX(CASE WHEN depth = max_depth - 1 THEN tag_name END) as second_name, MAX(CASE WHEN depth = max_depth - 1 THEN tag_code END) as second_code,
MAX(CASE WHEN depth = max_depth - 2 THEN id END) as third_id, MAX(CASE WHEN depth = max_depth - 2 THEN tag_name END) as third_name, MAX(CASE WHEN depth = max_depth - 2 THEN tag_code END) as third_code,
MAX(CASE WHEN depth = max_depth - 3 THEN id END) as fourth_id, MAX(CASE WHEN depth = max_depth - 3 THEN tag_name END) as fourth_name, MAX(CASE WHEN depth = max_depth - 3 THEN tag_code END) as fourth_code,
MAX(CASE WHEN depth = 1 THEN id END) as fifth_id, MAX(CASE WHEN depth = 1 THEN tag_name END) as fifth_name, MAX(CASE WHEN depth = 1 THEN tag_code END) as fifth_code,
-- 完整路径 GROUP_CONCAT(tag_name ORDER BY depth DESC SEPARATOR ' > ') as full_name_path, GROUP_CONCAT(tag_code ORDER BY depth DESC SEPARATOR ' > ') as full_code_path, GROUP_CONCAT(id ORDER BY depth DESC SEPARATOR ' > ') as full_id_path,
max_depth as total_levels FROM ( SELECT *, MAX(depth) OVER (PARTITION BY leaf_id) as max_depth FROM CTE ) as t GROUP BY leaf_id, tag_type, max_depth ORDER BY tag_type, leaf_id
select max(tag_code) from ins_tag_client
